description: This Java class handles commands to remove a loan officer from a loan within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, is annotated as a Spring Service, and uses dependency injection to call the LoanWritePlatformService for the removal operation.

classes.name: RemoveLoanOfficerCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the command to remove a loan officer from a loan; implements the processCommand method.

fields.name: writePlatformService
fields.description: Service used to perform loan write operations, injected via constructor.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to remove a loan officer by delegating to writePlatformService.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The command containing details for removing the loan officer.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Executes the removal of the loan officer based on the received command.
